meta.name: executing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按书面计划逐步执行代码实现并接受审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要按照计划分步骤实现功能并确保质量
copy.tagline_en: Execute implementation plans step by step with review checkpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to execute a written plan for coding and pass review checkpoints

howto.what: Claude 会加载一个书面执行计划，先审查计划并指出问题；若无问题则按步骤执行每个任务，每步验证；全部完成后调用另一个技能完成开发。
howto.when: 当你提供一个书面的实施计划，并要求 Claude 在一个独立会话中执行时触发。

say.note: Claude 会加载并开始执行计划。

say.text: 我已经写好了实现计划，开始执行吧。
say.note: Claude 会先审查计划，然后逐步执行。

say.text: 按照这个计划执行，遇到问题先暂停问我。
say.note: Claude 会在遇到阻碍时停止并询问你。

howto.what_en: Claude loads a written implementation plan, reviews it critically, then executes each task step by step with verifications. After all tasks are complete, it uses another skill to finish the development branch.
howto.when_en: When you provide a written implementation plan and ask Claude to execute it in a separate session with review checkpoints.

say_en.note: Claude will load and start executing the plan.

say_en.text: I have written the implementation plan, start executing.
say_en.note: Claude will review the plan first, then execute step by step.

say_en.text: Execute this plan, stop and ask me if you encounter any issues.
say_en.note: Claude will pause and ask for clarification when blocked.
